facts.text: Serve the mains when Lightning pulls into Flo's café in Radiator Springs.
facts.why: The transcript has no scene of Lightning pulling into Flo's. Flo sells gas, and the town relights its neon and cruises together later.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Radiator Springs relights its neon and the town cruises.

vibe.verdict: A well made Route 66 diner with the right cars and town, but it is mostly a plain diner menu with a few car puns.
missing: Mater and Lightning tractor tipping, honk and the bull (the field at night)
Fillmore blasting Hendrix at Sarge's morning flag (next door to Flo's)
Luigi 'Don't eat the radial! Take the snow tires!' (tyre shop)
Flo: 'I have gas... Lotsa gas!' (the court scene)
Doc Hudson's three Piston Cups kept in his garage
Lightning learning to turn left by turning right on the dirt track
ideas: Swap 'Fried pickles with ranch' note for 'Don't eat the radial. Here, take the snow tires.' to bring in Luigi's tractor gag.
Swap 'Southern sweet iced tea' for an 'Organic fuel' drink with a Fillmore note about the Hendrix flag.
Add a Flo gas joke ('Lotsa gas') as the note on the oil can float.
Swap the page one 'Today's Special' line for Doc's 'Sentenced to community service' blue plate.
changed: Route 66 chilli note now carries Lightning's pre-race mantra, Speed. I am speed. (transcript)
